mobileHeroHeight.rationale: On screens <= 767px (Mobile 390px and Narrow Mobile 360px), hero elements stack vertically (photo on top, copy below). Sizing heroes with height: auto preserves readable typography, full visibility of primary and secondary CTAs, and prevents awkward 150px+ whitespace gaps on pages with compact descriptions.
mobileHeroHeight.desktopCompliance: 100% matched within 0.0px across 26 pages on Desktop 1536x900 and Laptop 1366x768
mobileHeroHeight.tabletCompliance: 100% matched within 0.0px across 26 pages on Tablet 768x1024

dependencyAuditDevDependencies.rationale: Vulnerabilities detected by npm audit reside inside development tooling (@lhci/cli). Running 'npm audit fix --force' would force breaking major upgrades to Astro 7 and Tailwind 4, breaking the project's static Astro 5 architecture. The production dist/ output contains zero node runtime code and is completely immune to server-side dependency execution.

legacyRedirectStubs.rationale: Preserves inbound backlinks from legacy promotional campaigns.
